findings.location: src/services/saveService.ts:147–153 (current historical defender validation); pre-fix code required current s.npcs membership.
findings.priorBehavior: A valid contribution to a nonfeatured defender became unloadable after die() and normal simulate() crossed a day boundary: daily pruning removed that dead NPC and life record while the crisis ledger retained its historical reference. The generated save then failed deserialize().
findings.resolution: The validator accepts a canonical npc-<positive integer> reference below monotonic nextNpcId without requiring the NPC to remain in the current roster, while retaining strict bounds, donor character validity, unique allocation slots/source items and strict consumed-item snapshot validation. This preserves legitimate lifecycle history without granting an NPC reward owner.

findings.priorBehavior: An oversized food request that would lift a negative forecast above zero could return advice to add farmers, although the actual rejection reason was request size.
findings.resolution: The action distinguishes a genuinely zero-effect request from an over-request that would improve the raw forecast, and keeps both rejection paths mutation-free.

observations: All contribution actions preflight current crisis id/phase, living idle player, no combat/dungeon, village handoff location and safe event capacity before mutation. Invalid state, asset, slot, physical capacity, forecast or need rejects without changing state.

Equipment consumes only owned unequipped reward inventory, fills an actual free slot on a current eligible defender, caps at 16 allocations, snapshots rolled stats and provenance, and uses actual stat/suitability-derived per-slot effect. A reviewer-run public crafting path produced a real ironShortSword with craftProvenance; donation raised equipment readiness from 0 to 0.4321428571, removed the live reward item, preserved provenance in the ledger, did not advance time/RNG, and round-tripped exactly.

Food changes real settlement.food only within the physical 100 stockroom, per-crisis cap, raw resolution forecast and zero-marginal guard. Food contrast and over-request feedback RED/GREEN evidence is retained.
Gold consumes character gold only within a derived finite logistics shortage/cap and credits are exact-shaped, unique by donor, safe-integer bounded and sum-checked.

V4 validation occurs before migration; the V5 migration adds an empty bounded ledger while preserving the crisis snapshot, world time, RNG and lastSavedAt. Authenticated WARNING/PREPARATION/ACTIVE saves were generated and round-tripped using the committed V4 checkpoint, not relabeled V5 output.
The earlier synthetic V4 migration test failure was a stale-fixture issue; final archived V4 fixtures and three phase-specific migration cases pass. No V4 migration blocker remains.
No E/F UI, action, resolver or consequence implementation is part of this D change.
